A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ITA-MDT. All 26 pages in each version, including equations, tables, figures and supplementary material, support reliable comparison through text extraction and rendered inspection.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original virtual try-on evaluations, component ablations and qualitative results in Section 4, with further DressCode and sampling-step results in the supplementary material.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains these original empirical results, including the proposed model's evaluations in Tables 1, 3 and 4 and the supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: MDT-IVTON, ITAFA, SRE, the three training objectives and the DDIM/classifier-free guidance procedure remain unchanged in Section 3 and supplementary Sections 6–9.

E1.justification: Both versions use VITON-HD and the upper-body, lower-body and dresses subsets of DressCode. The supplementary garment examples and real-world SRE examples are also retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains LaDI-VTON, DCI-VTON, StableVITON, CAT-DM, TPD and IDM-VTON. The corresponding qualitative comparisons also retain the same methods.

E3.justification: The image resolutions, training budget, 30-step primary inference setting, LPIPS/SSIM/paired and unpaired FID evaluations, and supplementary 20–50-step sampling study are unchanged.

E4.justification: The component and high-resolution ablations, feature-weight analysis, SRE case studies, mask-reconstruction training curves and sampling-step analysis are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds or performance confidence intervals. Table 2 retains the same means and standard deviations describing garment complexity.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and the qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, the full model's VITON-HD FID remains 5.462 paired and 8.676 unpaired in Table 1. Figure 2's redraw preserves the reported comparison values.

T1.justification: The loss, feature-complexity, entropy and guidance definitions and equations remain unchanged in Section 3 and supplementary Sections 6–9.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning garment-detail preservation, computational efficiency and state-of-the-art results on selected metrics.

C2.justification: Interpretations of feature-layer weighting, dataset complexity, SRE behavior on uniform or wrinkled garments, controlled photographing conditions and sampling quality-speed trade-offs are unchanged.

D1.justification: Architecture specifications, hardware, hyperparameters, SRE preprocessing and runtime disclosures, and project-page access information are unchanged, including supplementary Sections 10 and 12.2.

R1.justification: The same 47 references and related-work discussion are retained, including positioning relative to DiT/MDT, diffusion-based virtual try-on methods and PICTURE.

P1.justification: The printed arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 26 March 2025 to v2 dated 1 June 2025. Prose, author information, headings and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is redrawn with larger legend text, revised typography and different plot proportions. Figures 3–5 show slight sizing or rendering differences. Captions, table structures and supplementary displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Figure 2's enlarged legend and revised typography make the main efficiency comparison easier to read. This provides a limited presentation improvement; the scientific content, empirical support and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
